parts.name: Cabinet Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left door of the cabinet, made of wood, rectangular in shape, and part of the storage furniture.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a movable cover to enclose and protect the contents of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around hinges attached to the cabinet frame, allowing it to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right door of the cabinet, made of wood, rectangular in shape, and part of the storage furniture.
parts.Functional_description: It works together with the left door to close the cabinet and protect stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around hinges attached to the cabinet frame, allowing it to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the cabinet, made of plywood, forming the outer shell and support structure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and supports the doors and shelves.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that holds all other components together.

parts.name: Shelf (Bottom)
parts.Basic_description: This is the bottom shelf of the cabinet, made of wood, rectangular in shape, and part of the internal storage structure.
parts.Functional_description: It supports items placed inside the cabinet, distributing weight evenly.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Middle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the middle shelf of the cabinet, made of wood, rectangular in shape, and part of the internal storage structure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides an additional level for organizing and storing items inside the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Top)
parts.Basic_description: This is the top shelf of the cabinet, made of wood, rectangular in shape, and part of the internal storage structure.
parts.Functional_description: It supports items placed near the top of the cabinet and helps organize storage space.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move during normal use.
